title: Map Component
description: Describes a data transformation — how to reshape one JSON object into another.

id.description: Unique identifier for this map component.

short_description.description: Human-readable summary of what this map does.

input.description: Where to read input data from. Usually a {{placeholder}} into shared space.

output.description: Where to store the mapped output. Usually a {{fn:store('key')}} call.

defaults.description: Default values applied to missing input fields before transformation.

overrides.description: Values forced onto input fields before transformation, missing or not.

base.description: A {{fn:call}} that performs the primary transformation. Returns an object.

defaults.description: source->target dot-path mappings applied for pairs the base did not provide.

overrides.description: source->target dot-path mappings always applied, regardless of base output.

resolver.description: Relative path to the Node.js resolver module for this map.
